summary: South American tournament was in US in 2024 and 2016Concacaf teams determined by 2027 Gold CupGames will overlap with Euro 2028 but not OlympicsThe 2028 Copa América will be played in the United States and expanded to include teams from the Concacaf region, bringing the landmark South American international competition to the US for a third time in five editions.Conmebol, the South American confederation that runs the tournament, and Concacaf, the confederation governing soccer in North and Central America and the Caribbean, jointly announced the long-rumored arrangement on Tuesday, framing it as an extension of a “strategic partnership” between the organizations.

summary: Ticketing model was in place for 2026 men’s World CupFans criticized system but Fifa saw record revenuesA dynamic pricing model is set to be used in ticket sales for games held in the United States at the 2031 Women’s World Cup, which will be co-hosted with Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica.Sources involved with the bid, which was formally ratified by Fifa on Monday, have told the Guardian it is inevitable that variable pricing will be used in the US after its successful application at last summer’s men’s World Cup, which generated about $5bn in ticket sales and hospitality, a significant increase on Fifa’s projection of $3.3bn.

stories.title: ‘I’m loving it at Brugge’: Freddie Potts on going from West Ham’s bench to Champions League
summary: Midfielder is preparing to face Liverpool after leaving the club he loves and overcoming a tough start in BelgiumIn April Freddie Potts was absorbing the disappointment of being substituted at half-time during West Ham’s FA Cup quarter-final defeat by Leeds.

The midfielder was out of favour under Nuno Espírito Santo and could not have imagined that he would be preparing to face Liverpool in the Champions League seven months later.It is the 23-year-old’s reward for taking the difficult decision to leave his boyhood club last summer.

Potts noticed his minutes were drying up in pre-season, even though West Ham were not exactly stocked with talent after relegation, and was ready for a new challenge when Club Brugge offered about £10m to sign him.

stories.title: The line between sports hero and gambling shill is fast disappearing
summary: Rival prediction market Polymarket, which relaunched in the US late last year after regulators shut it down in 2022, has seen similar growth over recent months.

The prediction market machine now sponsors Jalen Brunson and Josh Hart’s Roommates Show, on which the recently crowned pair of NBA champions begin every episode dutifully informing us that their amazingly dreary podcast is “presented by Polymarket, the top prediction market”.

Somehow we’ve arrived at the point where it’s bigger news if a professional athlete takes a firm stand against the prediction markets, as Victor Wembanyama recently did, rather than pockets the cash to endorse them.
